Second pass at the /pages/ingredients header. Replaces the three-serum product line-up published earlier today with the laboratory glassware frame.

WHY FRAMING A AND NOT C: Malcolm picked one candidate from each of two framings and said one should go on this page. The page decides which. The C pick is opposite-handed, subject left with the space on the right, and would need the page's text moved across; it is better held for a header that wants that.

SOURCE: banner-lab-glassware-product-colours wave, slot A, nbp_flash candidate 2. Class B — no product, no branding, nothing for an engine to invent. Liquids are the products' own scene colours: Clinical blue 014EB1 for Copper Peptide, Blush F3BFC2 for PDRN, and water-clear for the frosted-white products.

KNOWN DEPARTURE, and Malcolm picked it knowing: this candidate SWAPPED the briefed order — pink beaker left of the blue flask rather than blue then pink. It reads well alone; it just will not match other frames from the same wave if several are used together.

EXTENDED 1999 -> 3750x848 (4.42:1), standard sm header height. The left edge is clean and fringe-free (leftmost columns 23.3-23.7, adjacent deltas 0.79-0.86) so no edge_trim was needed. The texture box is rows 300-500 only: cols 0-400 LOOK uniformly dark and are not — rows 180-300 peak at 146 and rows 600-800 at 162, both background equipment catching light, and tiling either would have printed ghosts across the fill. Verified after the fact: brightest pixel anywhere in the 1751px fill is 53.

NO SECTION SETTINGS CHANGE. The banner already carries the liquid-block CSS, left text and 25% overlay from this morning's pass, so this swaps the two images and nothing else.
